官方资料核验于 2026 年 9 月 9 日。路线顺序与停留时长为 BAYLIN: Official sources checked on September 9, 2026. Route order and stop durations are BAYLINK editorial suggestions. Recheck prices, opening times, reservations and transport before visiting. Credited reference photos do not show guaranteed conditions, flowers or exhibitions on your travel date.
Oakland 不必绕湖一整圈：Lake Merritt 与 OMCA 的松弛半: An Oakland half-day: Lake Merritt and OMCA without a full lake loop
从 BART 出发，先看湖，再在加州艺术与花园里停下来: Start from BART, enjoy the lake, then slow down with California art and a garden
把 Lake Merritt 南侧与 OMCA 连成短程，给出免费花园和收费展厅: Connect southern Lake Merritt with OMCA, separating its free garden from ticketed galleries and offering family-friendly ways to keep the route short.
核对票种、Lake Merritt BART、停车与无障碍入口。: Check tickets, Lake Merritt BART, parking and accessible entrances.
免费花园随博物馆开放，临时关闭与聚会另有规则。: The free garden follows museum hours; closures and gatherings have separate rules.
了解湖区、铺装步道与园内设施；不是每项设施都免费。: Learn about the lake, paved paths and park facilities; not every attraction is free.
第一次逛 Lake Merritt，不需要用绕完整圈证明自己来过。把注意力放在南: You do not need to complete a full loop to enjoy Lake Merritt. Focus on the southern shore and its city views, then visit the Oakland Museum of California for another way to see California through art, history and natural science. Budget visitors can stay in the garden; those wanting gallery time can add a ticket.
选好看展日，分清花园与展厅: Choose a museum day and distinguish garden from gallery access
建议 3–4 小时：湖边约 45 分钟，花园约半小时，展厅按兴趣再留 1–2 小: Allow 3–4 hours: around 45 minutes by the lake, half an hour in the garden and another 1–2 hours for galleries if desired.
OMCA 通常周三至周日 11:00–17:00，周五延长到 21:00，周一、: OMCA normally opens Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m., and until 9 p.m. Fridays. It closes Monday and Tuesday; check holiday exceptions.
花园免费但有开放时间。全馆含特展票成人 $25、65+ $22、13–17 岁及: The garden is free during its opening hours. All-inclusive admission is $25 for adults, $22 for ages 65+, $18 for ages 13–17 and students/educators with valid ID, and free for children 12 and under. Check current first-Sunday terms separately.
把湖边与博物馆连成半天: Connect the lakeshore and museum in a half-day
以博物馆为锚点的小环线: A short route anchored at the museum
停留时长是编辑建议，不含往返交通；按现场开放和同行者体力调整。: Suggested stop durations are editorial estimates and exclude travel to and from the area. Adjust for closures and your group’s energy.
从 Oak Street 一侧确认去 OMCA 的方向；博物馆主入口在 1000: Orient yourself toward OMCA from Oak Street; the main entrance is at 1000 Oak Street. Identify your return station entrance first.
沿开放的公共步道看水鸟和天际线，走到舒服的折返点就返回。别临时把北端所有景点都加: Follow open public paths for waterbirds and skyline views, turning back when ready. Avoid adding every attraction at the north end; activities and food have separate costs.
从开放入口进花园，先看本土植物与台地空间；买票后再选一个最感兴趣的展厅。孩子可用: Enter the garden through an open entrance and notice native plants and terraces. With a ticket, choose the gallery that interests you most. Children can look for one animal, one object and one artwork before returning to BART.
OMCA 距 Lake Merritt BART 约一个街区，适合把停车任务省掉: OMCA is about one block from Lake Merritt BART, making transit convenient. Drivers should use the museum’s listed garage and check its hours; the usual rate is $5 per hour. Ramps, an elevator and accessible restrooms are available, but the highest roof gardens are not reached by elevator. Ask the desk for a step-free route. Keep meals out of the galleries.
离开前，留好返程与休息时间: Leave time for rest and the trip home
先选免费花园版还是含展厅版，预算加入交通与餐饮。: Choose the free-garden or gallery version; budget for transport and meals.
查周一、二闭馆与节假日安排，购票前确认特展内容。: Check Monday/Tuesday and holiday closures, and review exhibitions before buying.
约好湖边折返点；推车和轮椅路线向馆方核对。: Agree on a lakeside turnaround point; confirm stroller and wheelchair routes with the museum.
打开官方页面，按实际出行日期核对后再订票或出发。: Check the official page for your travel date before booking or setting out.
把实际体验留给下一位湾区邻居: Share your visit with the next Bay Area neighbor
欢迎分享当天的开放提醒、适合同行者的短路线和一张自己拍的照片；约同行时写明日期、: Share current access notes, a shorter route that worked for your group and a photo you took. When arranging company, include the date, meeting point, transport and expected finish time.
